hero.title: I build systems end-to-end.
hero.sub: Self-taught full-stack developer out of the hospitality world. I design, build, secure and ship complete web platforms — and I sweat the details, because I spent 14 years in a job where details are everything.
hero.open: Open to opportunities — development · security · automation

about.title: From bar counters to cloud consoles.
about.p1: Most developers learn to handle pressure from production incidents. I learned it from a full bar on match night. Same skill: stay calm, triage fast, fix the right thing first.
about.p2: I taught myself the MERN stack and went straight for the hard parts — authentication, cloud infrastructure, internationalization, deployment. Not because a course said so, but because my own product needed them.
about.p3: Now I'm going deeper into security: hardening what I build, understanding how it breaks, and aiming my curiosity at cybersecurity as a discipline.

stack.title: The stack I actually ship with.
stack.sub: Every item below is in production code I wrote — not a logo wall.

project.title: One platform, four clouds.
project.name: vardges.me — Operations Platform
project.desc: A production MERN platform I designed, built and deployed solo: an operations dashboard for managing dark-kitchen restaurant chains, with file storage that can live on any of four cloud providers.

bullets.title: Multi-cloud storage engine
bullets.text: One interface over Google Cloud Storage, AWS S3, Cloudflare R2 and Azure Blob — with live health pings and provider monitoring built in.

bullets.title: Security first
bullets.text: Server-side sessions in MongoDB, Helmet headers, secure cookies behind an AWS load balancer, and a validator layer in front of every write.

bullets.title: Speaks four languages
bullets.text: Full internationalization in English, Russian, Armenian and Arabic — including right-to-left layout support.

bullets.title: Really deployed
bullets.text: AWS EC2 behind an Application Load Balancer with CodeBuild CI, health endpoints designed for the balancer's checks.

project.stackLine: React · Node · Express · MongoDB · AWS · GCP · Cloudflare · Azure
project.mockNote: Live provider health — a real feature of the platform

security.title: Built paranoid, on purpose.
security.sub: Hospitality teaches you to spot trouble before it reaches the bar. I write software the same way.

cards.title: Defense in depth
cards.text: Every request passes route guards, validators and sanitizers before it ever touches data.

cards.title: Least privilege
cards.text: Scoped IAM roles per cloud provider — nothing gets one permission more than it needs.

cards.title: Hardened sessions
cards.text: Server-side sessions, secure cookies, and trust-proxy configured correctly behind the load balancer.

cards.title: Breaking to learn
cards.text: Moving deeper into offensive and defensive security — labs, CTFs and a healthy distrust of my own code.
